source_evidence: The ability to annuitize your variable annuity offers protection against the possibility that you will outlive your assets.
question: How can choosing lifetime income from a variable annuity help address longevity risk?
answer: When you annuitize, you turn your contract value into regular income payments. Choosing payments for your lifetime can help protect against the possibility of outliving your assets. The contract may also offer payments for your lifetime or your spouse’s lifetime.
